Character cast — their owl has friends now

Which Character Are You?LIVE
PERSONALITY QUIZ · 3 TAPS
Monday energy, group-chat role, superpower → “You’re SO Lily!” Your result is an official cast member (Lily·Zari·Eddy·Oscar·Lucy·Falstaff) with their real art.
Tests: identity hook v2 — does a character result beat the language result (round-1’s crowd favorite)?
Duolingo_CharacterQuiz_3T.html
Beat EddyLIVE
RACE · 3+ TAPS
Race Eddy through 3 picture-words before his bar fills. His official Correct/Incorrect art reacts to every answer — win and he pouts, stall and he gloats. Both endings convert.
Tests: competition — a rival with a face. Untested thesis in the account.
Duolingo_BeatEddy_3plus.html
Read Lily’s MoodLIVE
EMOTION MATCH · 3 TAPS
Enojada, cansada or tímida? Match the Spanish word to Lily’s official expression art. Faces are universal — zero localization risk.
Tests: meme-famous character + real vocab — brand affinity as the hook.
Duolingo_LilyMood_3T.html

Brand mechanics & arcade

Passport World TourLIVE
COLLECT · 3 TAPS
Say hello in France, Japan and Italy — each right answer slams a stamp into your passport. “3 countries in 30 seconds.”
Tests: collection/completionist loop + the 40-languages breadth promise.
Duolingo_Passport_3T.html
League ClimbLIVE
LEADERBOARD · 3 TAPS
Start rank #4 among the official cast; every correct answer leapfrogs you up the leaderboard to 👑 #1. Duolingo’s leagues loop as the acquisition hook.
Tests: status/competition retention mechanic — sibling thesis to the in-campaign Streak Saver.
Duolingo_LeagueClimb_3T.html
Word Balloon PopLIVE
ARCADE · 3 TAPS
Three balloons drift up — pop the right Spanish word before they float away. Feels like a game, not a lesson; built for gaming-app placements.
Tests: arcade skin — does game-feel win in gaming inventory where these packs run?
